sloka: ततस्तस्य परिज्ञाय महास्थैर्यं महामुनेः ।ज्ञात्वा तपसि सिद्धिं च पत्न्यर्थं स्पर्शिता तदा ।। ७.३०.२९ ॥
transliteration: tatastasya parijñāya mahāsthairyaṁ mahāmuneḥ ।jñātvā tapasi siddhiṁ ca patnyarthaṁ sparśitā tadā ।। 7.30.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, having understood the great steadfastness of that great sage and his success in penance, she was offered to him as a wife.
